oneSentenceStory: Review expiring points calmly and understand options for protecting accumulated value without artificial urgency.
customerSituation: Customer has accumulated a substantial points balance with a portion expiring in 9 days, amidst a recent stall in contributions.
storyTension: Potential loss of expiring points creates quiet friction against long-term disciplined saving habits.
customerResolution: Customer calmly reviews factual expiration details and reallocates or protects points within their existing long-term goals.
primaryOutcome: Gain clear, pressure-free visibility into long-term savings trajectory and options for protecting accumulated value.
